player_intent: The purchased Mark 23 appears as a human-scale two-hand pistol and remains in the pistol family through standing, movement, crouch, accepted-shot recovery, dive, and return.
acceptance_rule: The canonical Mark 23 profile renders Pistol_2 at 0.20-0.25 meters, provides authored grip and bore sockets, resolves as TWO_HAND_PISTOL, uses pistol idle and locomotion clips, and routes standing and crouched FIRE_ACCEPTED to the pistol recoil layer for the existing 1.2-second recovery. Equipment replacement clears the previous weapon's fire, frame-socket, stock, and IK solver presentation state without changing locomotion, dive/roll, reload, camera/reticle aim, or authoritative shot and damage owners.

nodes.role: Loads the calibrated Mark 23 mesh and creates its authored trigger, support-hand, barrel-base, muzzle, ejection, optic, and non-stock diagnostic sockets.

must_not_change: CharacterBody3D movement, posture, collision, dive, and roll authority
SOCOM camera and reticle aim-intent authority
server muzzle validation, accepted shot, ballistics, damage, and networking authority
rifle visual profile, rifle family routes, and rifle fire recovery
reload completion and explicit fire-interrupt semantics
visual_check: Buy and equip MARK 23 in res://main.tscn. Confirm the visible firearm is pistol-sized, its right hand remains at the trigger grip, its left hand stays at the two-hand grip, and its barrel points along the reticle-facing weapon line. Stand, move, crouch, fire in both postures, dive, and return; the operator must remain in the pistol family with no rifle-sized mesh, rifle stock solve, overhead rifle pose, or rifle fire/Aim Idle route.

system_delta.reason: Replace the sparse catalog presentation and generated rifle-length sockets with a complete per-model Mark 23 calibration, explicit pistol event routes, and replacement-safe solver defaults. Merge those changes into the existing equipment, animation-profile, and visual-rig owners while preserving gameplay authority.

current.system: Sparse Mark 23 catalog profile normalized with generic rifle-scale mount, contacts, muzzle, and fallback fire route

candidate.system: Canonical per-model Mark 23 visual contract with explicit TWO_HAND_PISTOL routes and clean solver replacement
